## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `e2833f914872f06fe35da9f83d996a8127fbb209`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #37487 (body; comments 7186889924, 7189270058, 7190147175, claim 7190899980, amendment 7191223613, os-dev report 7192922175), the PR body, `git diff origin/main...pr-37539-x` (15 files, +502/−27), the head's check-runs (all green: Type Check UI, Test UI 16/16 shards, Lint UI, Check Changeset, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI; the rest success or skipped, 0 failed), PR #37485's records 7186860933 and 7190126794 for the `Clause-②` precedent, and the area's L1 notes as one input. Nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept set: unchanged, right.** The citations list is read back through `extractRecordCitations`, which is the same `RecordCitationsSchema` parse a live part goes through. That schema is a strict object capped at `RECORD_CITATIONS_MAX` (20), and re-parsing a list that already parsed gives the same list. A refused list is not written to the cache and draws nothing. Nothing is verified again (ruling Q1). There is a control on each of the three paths.

**Allow-list: keeps what a reload needs, drops nothing that was kept before.** I checked all three paths against `main`. Each one gains something and loses nothing.
- Cache writer: it used to write `chartAnswerParts(content, charts)`. It now writes `storedAnswerParts`, which is that same output plus at most one `data-record-citations` part. User turns get the same text parts as before.
- `useObjectChat` writer: same as the cache writer, with the reasoning part still appended after.
- History reader: it used to run `chartsFromParts`. It now runs `storedAnswerData`, which returns the charts plus the citations.

The other data parts the mapper reads (`data-build-progress`, `data-blueprint-progress`) were not kept before this PR and are still not kept, so no reader loses anything a user saw. The share page (`SharedRecordPage`) also goes through `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages`. But `aiMessageRowsToServerMessages` turns an assistant row into text plus tool calls only, so no citations part reaches it and nothing changes there.

**Module memory (S5): no leak, bounded, reset correctly.** I read `claimCitedSectionOpen` and the counter of mounted record pages beside it.
- It holds one slot (`{ target, opened }`) and one counter, so it cannot grow.
- It can only hold back a scroll. It never causes one, and the mark always comes from the page's own candidates.
- `target` is `objectName:recordId` plus the anchor. A different record or anchor never matches, so it can never give a second record the first one's section effect.
- Each click id is unique (`Date.now` plus a counter). A real chip click always claims and scrolls.
- It cannot leak across users or sessions. It lives only in this JS realm: a reload or a new tab starts empty. Sign-out unmounts the record page, and the zero-delay check then clears the slot.
- A remount in the same commit keeps the slot, because the new mount's effect runs before the timer fires. Strict-mode double effects stay balanced.
- `focusRecordSection` calls `finish()` before its single scroll, so asking `mayScroll` there cannot suppress a second scroll that the page needed.

**Public surface: widened.** That is right as a change, but it is declared wrong (S1).
- New on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, all absent on `main`:
  - root and `./core`: `storedAnswerParts`, `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS`, and the types `StoredAnswerData` and `StoredAnswerPart`;
  - root only: `storedAnswerData`.
- The package is published. It is not `private`, it has `exports` for `.` and `./core`, and it sits in the `fixed` group with `access: public`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private`, so its new `CacheableChatMessage.recordCitations` field is not public surface.

**Pins guard the behaviour.**
- Allow-list: a pin ties the allow-list entry to `RECORD_CITATIONS_PART_TYPE`. Disabling the citations entry in writer and reader turns 3 tests red.
- S5 in-mount: reading the key back off the state turns its test red.
- S5 remount: making `claimCitedSectionOpen` always claim turns the remount test red.
- Memory reset: there is no named pin, but it is held in effect. The setext case remounts `?section=scope` after `cleanup()` plus one macrotask, and expects a scroll. Without the reset, that case would fail.

### ② Semver level

**Changeset level: right.** `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/app-shell` is correct: `Metadata-protocol: none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol widening also ships `patch` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3). The two packages are exactly the ones whose `src` the diff moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right, since no metadata author can write anything new.

S1 (must-fix) — `Clause-②: no` is wrong; it should read `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- The test is whether the change widens the accept set or the public surface. Five exports are new on a published package's root, and four of them also on `./core` (① above).
- The seat's precedent on PR #37485 graded a new optional member and a new reserved URL parameter as widening, under `Clause-②: yes`. A new named export is at least as public as either.
- The amendment 7191223613 left the final line to this review, and the PR body says the same. A wrong `no` is an auditable false declaration.
- Fix: put `Clause-②: yes (widening)` at line start in both the PR body and the changeset body. Name the new exports in the changeset body, as the package's own CHANGELOG did for `chartsFromParts` / `chartAnswerParts`. The level stays `patch`, and no `!` is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none.
- The PR body's flag ("`Clause-②: no` kept, for the area to judge at L1"): answered by S1.
- Out-of-scope finding, phone dock sheet covering the cited heading: carried by #37556 (open). Answered.
- Out-of-scope finding, N6/N7 of 7190147175: escalated to area ai-36996. Their only carrier is #37487, and `Fixes #37487` closes it on merge. File a carrier card for them before this lands.
- Deviations: answered.
  - The S4 run injected the history part and a one-agent catalog. The card allowed that (7186889924) and the PR says so.
  - Single-file reruns ran outside the verify lock. That is moot, because CI ran every family green on this head.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff reads no data and adds no query, id materialisation or join. It only reshapes parts that are already in memory.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract):
- N1 (nit) — `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS` names the kept parts, but it does not drive the code.
  - `storedAnswerData` reads `chartsFromParts` and the spec constant, and `chartAnswerParts` writes its own `'data-chart'` literal.
  - So "a part added to the allow-list is read wherever it is written" (jsdoc in `mapMessages.ts`) and "a further kept part is one entry in the allow-list" (PR body) both overstate it. Today a new kept part needs edits in three places.
  - The jsdoc in `toolResultParsers.ts` also cites `storedAnswerParts.recordCitations-37487.test.ts`, which does not exist. The pin is in `useObjectChat.recordCitationsReload-37487.test.tsx`.
- N2 (nit) — The in-mount `sectionOpened` and the shared slot both outlive moves between records while a `RecordDetailView` stays mounted. Embedded drawer or split-pane views count as mounted too.
  - Effect: a stateless in-app link back to a section that was already opened would mark it but not scroll.
  - Today that is not reachable in the app: only chips write `?section=`, and each one carries a fresh state value. Same as the area's L1 N1.

1. **Shape**: open draft against `main`, `Fixes #37487`. 15 files, +502/−27. Not governed. No review face, so the declaration face applies at `TIER_DEFAULT`.
2. **Premise**: one allow-list now governs stored data parts on all three rebuild paths. Each path keeps a superset of what `main` kept, so a reload loses nothing the user saw. The module-level section memory holds a single slot, is keyed by object, record id and anchor, cannot cause a scroll, and clears once no record page is mounted. The code holds.
3. **Gates**: contract record 7193217253 reads **FAIL**, on a declaration only. CI on this head is green.
4. **Owed for the delta (prose and changeset only)**:
   - **S1**: `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` is published and gains five exports: `storedAnswerParts`, `STORED_ANSWER_DATA_PARTS`, `StoredAnswerData` and `StoredAnswerPart` on `.` and `./core`, and `storedAnswerData` on `.`. Write `Clause-②: yes (widening)` in both the changeset and the PR body, and name the exports in the changeset. The level stays `patch`, with no `!`. This follows the seat's precedent from #37485.
   - N1: the allow-list jsdoc overclaims (adding a part takes three edits) and cites a test file that does not exist. Fix it in the same push if cheap.
   - N2 (the section memory outlives moves between records while the page stays mounted) is accepted; no in-app path reaches it today.
   - Before merge: `Fixes #37487` closes the only card carrying N6 and N7 from 7190147175. File a follow-up card for them under #37487's parent, and name it in the PR body. The phone dock-sheet finding already has #37556.
5. **Out of scope and where it went**: #37556, plus the N6/N7 card to be filed.
6. **Next**: push, then knock. The delta reads S1. After ACCEPT, area ai-36996 lands it.
